paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within a dataset. The chart is divided into three slices, labeled "Null," "Have reference answer," and "Have test case." The slices are colored light red, blue, and light green respectively. The slice representing "Null" occupies approximately 39.2% of the chart, while "Have reference answer" accounts for about 38.9%, and "Have test case" for roughly 21.9%. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, and the chart includes a legend indicating the color corresponding to each category. One slice, "Have test case," is visually offset from the center of the chart. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest based on their area.
